senses.gloss:
यौग यौग, अस्, m. (fr. योग), a follower
of the Yoga system of philosophy.

यौगक, अस्, ई, अम्, relating to the religious
exercise called Yoga; [cf. यौगिक.]

यौगन्धर or यौगन्धरक, अस्, ई, अम्
(fr. युगन्-धर), relating to Yugan-dhara.

यौगन्धरायण, अस्, m. (fr. युगन्-धर
and योगन्-धर), a patronymic; N. of a minister
of Udayana.

यौगन्धरायणीय, अस्, ई, अम्, relating or
belonging to Yaugandharāyaṇa.
यौगन्धरि, इस्, m. a king of the Yugan-dharas.

यौगपद्य, अम्, n. (fr. युग-पद्), simulta-
neousness, contemporaneousness; यौगपद्येन =
युग-पद्, simultaneously, together.

यौगवरत्र, अम्, n. = युग-वरत्राणां स-
मूह, see Gaṇa Khaṇḍikādi to Pāṇ. IV. 2, 45.

यौगिक, अस्, ई, अम्, useful, applicable; proper,
customary, usual; belonging to a remedy, remedial;
derivative, suiting the derivation, agreeing with the
etymology, derived from the etymology, (यौगिकी
सञ्ज्ञा, a word retaining that signification which
belongs to it according to its etymology; यौगिक-
रूढ, a word which has both an etymological and
special meaning, cf. योग-रूढ); relating to the
Yoga, proceeding or derived from the Yoga.
